lastCompletedStory.title: Ignore the three uncovered cam runtime artifacts in the repo's own .gitignore

nextStoryContext: US-001 added three per-artifact .gitignore rules at repo root next to the existing cam-recycle-watcher.log block: .claude/cam-sidecar-liveness-watcher.log, .claude/.cam-sidecar-liveness-watcher.pid, .claude/.cam-merge-watch.json, each tagged with a CAM-502 comment. Only the repo's own .gitignore was touched (per notes SCOPE); templates/.gitignore is untouched by design and is owned by US-002, which will change it on this same branch next.
